repos_data.description: High-performance, scalable time-series database designed for Industrial IoT (IIoT) scenarios

MCP server for predictive maintenance and machinery fault diagnosis. Gives AI assistants evidence-based vibration analysis - FFT, envelope, bearing fault detection, ISO 20816-3 severity - with a measured, blind CWRU benchmark. Local-first: raw signals never leave your machine. Includes a Claude Code plugin.
